tool.name: OGS: Layers2Grid
tool.description: Reads a list of 2D unstructured mesh layers and samples them onto a structured grid of the same extent.
tool.command: #import re : > 'input.txt'; #set $safe_names = [re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) for $item in $input] #if len($safe_names) != len(set($safe_names)) #set $joined = ', '.join($safe_names) echo 'error: the element identifiers map to the same file name after characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_.@-] are replaced by _: $joined' >&2; exit 1; #end if #for $item in $input #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$item' '$safe_name'; echo '$safe_name' >> 'input.txt'; #end for Layers2Grid $dilate #if str($cellsize_z) --cellsize-z '$cellsize_z' #end if #if str($cellsize_y) --cellsize-y '$cellsize_y' #end if --cellsize-x '$cellsize_x' --input 'input.txt' --output output_1.vtu

param.label: dilate
param.help: assign mat IDs based on single nodes instead of a majority of nodes, which can result in a slightly increased voxel grid extent

param.label: cellsize z
param.help: edge length of cubes in z-direction (depth)

param.label: cellsize y
param.help: edge length of cubes in y-direction (latitude)

param.label: cellsize x
param.help: edge length of cubes in x-direction (longitude) or all directions, if y and z are not set

param.label: mesh layers
param.help: Mesh layers, ordered from top to bottom.

tool.help: Reads a list of 2D unstructured mesh layers and samples them onto a structured grid of the same extent. Note, that a large cube size may result in an undersampling of the original structure. Cube sizes are defines by x/y/z-parameters. For equilateral cubes, only the x-parameter needs to be set.
